other low L462-L474
Cross-counter `Relaxed` ordering can yield `failure_rate > 1.0`: error path increments `TOTAL_WRITES` then `FAILED_WRITES` with Relaxed, and this reader loads both with Relaxed. Under contention, the reader can observe `failed_count > total` (failed B's increment visible, but matching total B's increment not yet), making `failed/total` exceed 1.0. The audit event then logs an invalid rate. Either use `Ordering::SeqCst` for these counters, or clamp with `failed_count.min(total)`, or compute `failed/total` once and store it.

Suggested Change

    let failed_count = FAILED_WRITES.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
    if total > 0 {
        let failure_rate = (failed_count.min(total)) as f64 / total as f64;
        if failure_rate > FAILURE_THRESHOLD {
            crate::audit_event!(
                app,
                AuditLevel::Warn,
                "evolution.shadow_warning",

                "failed" => failed_count,

        }

Both need to consult this helper (or its logic) before `from_proposal`/`auto_applied_from_proposal` produces a `change_id`. Consider moving `next_unique_change_id` to a shared module (e.g. `evolution::change`) so apply / shadow / panel all funnel through the same line-level uniqueness guarantee — otherwise the panel-side fix is a partial patch over a shared jsonl that other writers corrupt.

15|//!   记忆 key、应用时间、impact、summary），审计与人工回滚的依据；
16|//! - AppHandle 复用 `emit` 的全局注册（`post_consolidation` 签名不变的约束不变）；
17|//! - importance 从 impact 派生（High=4 / Medium=3），source="system"——
18|//!   可淘汰、非受保护，记忆库满时按既有淘汰分正常出局。
19|
20|use rusqlite::Connection;
21|
22|use super::proposal::{EvolutionProposal, ImpactLevel, ProposalCategory};
23|use crate::memory::store::{self, NewItem};
24|
25|/// 自动应用门槛（纯函数）：仅 MemoryHint + High/Medium。
26|pub(crate) fn auto_apply_gate(p: &EvolutionProposal) -> bool {
27|    p.category == ProposalCategory::MemoryHint && p.impact != ImpactLevel::Low
28|}
29|
30|/// 提案对应的记忆幂等 key（tags[0]）。
31|pub fn evolution_key(proposal_id: &str) -> String {
32|    format!("evo:{proposal_id}")
33|}
34|
35|/// 单条应用结果。
36|#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
37|pub enum ApplyOutcome {
38|    /// 新写入一条 lesson 记忆
39|    Applied,
40|    /// 同 key 已存在（持久幂等命中），跳过
41|    AlreadyPresent,
42|    /// B2-1（P1-EV3）：merge-on-write 命中异 key 既有行被拒写（防记忆劫持）——
43|    /// 调用方记 evolution.apply_conflict audit（store 层无 AppHandle）
44|    ConflictRefused { target_key: String },
45|}
46|
47|/// 批量应用报告。
48|#[derive(Debug, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
49|pub struct ApplyReport {
50|    pub applied: usize,
51|    pub already_present: usize,
52|    /// B2-1：拒写（防劫持）条数
53|    pub conflicts_refused: usize,
54|}
55|
56|/// 应用单条提案（纯函数内核，注入连接与向量，内存库可单测）：
57|/// 幂等查重 → 写 lesson 记忆。语义去重由 `insert_item` 承担（≥0.92 合并更新）。
58|///
59|/// 调用前先过 `auto_apply_gate`；本函数不再重复判定类别/门槛。
60|/// B2-1（P1-EV3）幂等双保险：`find_by_key_tag` 只认 tags[0]，lesson 被 merge
61|/// 吸收/挪位后 key 查不到会重复应用——补两层残留复查：
62|/// ① key tag 出现在**任意** tag 位（挪位不丢）；② 同 kind=lesson 且内容逐字相同
63|/// （吸收后内容残存）。真正的语义相似由 store 层拒写闸兜底（ConflictRefused）。
64|pub fn apply_one(
65|    conn: &Connection,
66|    p: &EvolutionProposal,
67|    embedding: Option<&[f32]>,
68|    now_ms: i64,
69|) -> Result<ApplyOutcome, String> {
70|    let key = evolution_key(&p.proposal_id);
71|    let all = store::load_all(conn)?;
72|    if all.iter().any(|m| m.tags.iter().any(|t| t == &key)) {
73|        return Ok(ApplyOutcome::AlreadyPresent);
74|    }
75|    if all
76|        .iter()
77|        .any(|m| m.kind == "lesson" && m.content == p.suggestion.text)
78|    {
79|        return Ok(ApplyOutcome::AlreadyPresent);
80|    }
81|    drop(all);
82|    let item = NewItem {
83|        kind: "lesson".to_string(),
84|        content: p.suggestion.text.clone(),
85|        tags: vec![key, "evolution".to_string()],
86|        importance: match p.impact {
87|            ImpactLevel::High => 4,
88|            _ => 3,
89|        },
90|        source: "system".to_string(),
91|    };
92|    let (outcome, _merged_ids) = store::insert_item(conn, &item, embedding, now_ms)?;
93|    match outcome {
94|        store::InsertOutcome::RefusedForeignMerge { target_key } => {
95|            Ok(ApplyOutcome::ConflictRefused { target_key })
96|        }
97|        _ => Ok(ApplyOutcome::Applied),
98|    }
99|}
100|
101|/// 回滚：删除某提案落下的记忆。返回是否有条目被删。
102|pub fn rollback_applied(conn: &Connection, proposal_id: &str) -> Result<bool, String> {
103|    store::delete_by_key_tag(conn, &evolution_key(proposal_id))
104|}
105|
106|/// applied.jsonl 的一行记录。
107|#[derive(serde::Serialize)]
108|struct AppliedRecord<'a> {
109|    proposal_id: &'a str,
110|    mem_key: String,
111|    applied_at_ms: i64,
112|    impact: &'a str,
113|    summary: &'a str,
114|}
115|
116|/// 追加一条应用留痕（纯函数内核，路径由调用方给，测试用临时文件）。
117|pub fn append_applied_record(
118|    path: &std::path::Path,
119|    p: &EvolutionProposal,
120|    now_ms: i64,
121|) -> Result<(), String> {
122|    let rec = AppliedRecord {
123|        proposal_id: &p.proposal_id,
124|        mem_key: evolution_key(&p.proposal_id),
125|        applied_at_ms: now_ms,
126|        impact: p.impact.as_str(),
127|        summary: &p.evidence.summary,
128|    };
129|    let line = serde_json::to_string(&rec).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
130|    if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
131|        std::fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
132|    }
133|    use std::io::Write;
134|    let mut f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
135|        .create(true)
136|        .append(true)
137|        .open(path)
138|        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
139|    writeln!(f, "{line}").map_err(|e| e.to_string())
140|}
141|
142|/// 门面：consolidate 反思后的应用入口（`post_consolidation` 调用）。
143|///
144|/// 入参应已过 `auto_apply_gate`。内部派生独立阻塞任务（嵌入在持锁前算，
145|/// 与 memory 门面层同纪律），fire-and-forget：失败只进 audit / eprintln，
146|/// 不影响 consolidate 主链路。
147|pub fn apply_from_consolidation(proposals: Vec<EvolutionProposal>) {
148|    if proposals.is_empty() {
149|        return;
150|    }
151|    let Some(app) = super::emit::app_handle() else {
152|        eprintln!(
153|            "[evolution] AppHandle 未注册，跳过 apply（{} 条提案）",
154|            proposals.len()
155|        );
156|        return;
157|    };
158|    let app = app.clone();
159|
160|    // [R6 A] shadow 钩子（仅当 evolution.shadow.enabled=true 时）
161|    // 克隆 proposals 供 shadow spawn（主 apply 仍用原 proposals）
162|    let shadow_proposals = if crate::evolution::observe::shadow::is_enabled(&app) {
163|        Some(proposals.clone())
164|    } else {
165|        None
166|    };
167|    // [R6 A] 先 clone app 供 shadow spawn（主 spawn 会移走 app）
168|    let app_for_shadow = app.clone();
169|
170|    tauri::async_runtime::spawn(async move {
171|        let app2 = app.clone();
172|        let r = tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || -> Result<ApplyReport, String> {
173|            // 嵌入在持锁前批量算好（ONNX 推理数十 ms，不占 DB 写锁临界区）
174|            let embs: Vec<Option<Vec<f32>>> = proposals
175|                .iter()
176|                .map(|p| crate::memory::embed::embed_text(&p.suggestion.text))
177|                .collect();
178|            // embed_text 返回 None = 空文本或推理失败（调用侧不可区分）——
179|            // 无向量的 lesson 永不可语义召回，留痕不静默（audit 落 bot.log）。
180|            let embed_failed = embs.iter().filter(|e| e.is_none()).count();
181|            if embed_failed > 0 {
182|                crate::audit_event!(
183|                    &app2,
184|                    crate::audit::AuditLevel::Warn,
185|                    "evolution.embed_failed",
186|                    "failed" => embed_failed.to_string(),
187|                    "total" => proposals.len().to_string(),
188|                );
189|            }
190|            // 锁外预计算：open_db（文件打开 syscall，内部不拿 DB_WRITE_LOCK）、
191|            // ledger 路径、now——不占临界区
192|            let conn = crate::db::open_db(&app2)?;
193|            let now = crate::memory::now_ms();
194|            let ledger = crate::db::paths::data_dir(&app2).join("evolution-applied.jsonl");
195|            // DDL 单独一个短临界区
196|            {
197|                let _g = crate::db::DB_WRITE_LOCK.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| {
198|                    eprintln!("[mutex_poisoned] evolution::apply DB_WRITE_LOCK: {e:?}");
199|                    e.into_inner()
200|                });
201|                store::ensure_table(&conn)?;
202|            }
203|            let mut report = ApplyReport::default();
204|            for (p, emb) in proposals.iter().zip(embs.iter()) {
205|                // 临界区仅覆盖 SQL 写；jsonl append + audit emit 在锁外——
206|                // 无关 DB 写者不再被整条流水线（syscall/emit）串行化
207|                let outcome = {
208|                    let _g = crate::db::DB_WRITE_LOCK.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| {
209|                        eprintln!("[mutex_poisoned] evolution::apply DB_WRITE_LOCK: {e:?}");
210|                        e.into_inner()
211|                    });
212|                    apply_one(&conn, p, emb.as_deref(), now)?
213|                };
214|                match outcome {
215|                    ApplyOutcome::Applied => {
216|                        report.applied += 1;
217|                        append_applied_record(&ledger, p, now)?;
218|                        // B1-3（P0-EV2 另半）：补写 ChangeRecord（Active + AutoApplied）
219|                        // 到 evolution-changes.jsonl——面板回滚只读这个文件，此前自动
220|                        // 应用只落 applied.jsonl（面板不读它），回滚对自动应用不可达。
221|                        // 构造走 change::derive::auto_applied_from_proposal（合法流转，
222|                        // 不裸写 status）；构造/落盘失败仅 Warn audit——lesson 已生效，
223|                        // 不让留痕问题炸掉整条 apply。
224|                        let cr_path =
225|                            crate::db::paths::data_dir(&app2).join("evolution-changes.jsonl");
226|                        // B2-2（P1-EV4）：changes.jsonl 收敛单写者锁——apply 与
227|                        // shadow/panel 同锁（EVOLUTION_STORE_LOCK），闭包内同步持锁
228|                        // 不跨 await。锁序：此处 DB_WRITE_LOCK 已释放才取本锁，
229|                        // 与 panel（本锁内开 DB 连接）无环。
230|                        match super::change::derive::auto_applied_from_proposal(p, now) {
231|                            Ok(cr) => {
232|                                let _store = super::lock_evolution_store();
233|                                if let Err(e) = super::change::append_change(&cr_path, &cr) {
234|                                    crate::audit_event!(
235|                                        &app2,
236|                                        crate::audit::AuditLevel::Warn,
237|                                        "evolution.apply_change_record_failed",
238|                                        "proposal_id" => p.proposal_id.clone(),
239|                                        "error" => e,
240|                                    );
241|                                }
242|                            }
243|                            Err(e) => {
244|                                crate::audit_event!(
245|                                    &app2,
246|                                    crate::audit::AuditLevel::Warn,
247|                                    "evolution.apply_change_record_failed",
248|                                    "proposal_id" => p.proposal_id.clone(),
249|                                    "error" => e,
250|                                );
251|                            }
252|                        }
253|                        crate::audit_event!(
254|                            &app2,
255|                            crate::audit::AuditLevel::Info,
256|                            "evolution.applied",
257|                            "proposal_id" => p.proposal_id.clone(),
258|                            "impact" => p.impact.as_str(),
259|                            "mem_key" => evolution_key(&p.proposal_id),
260|                        );
261|                    }
262|                    ApplyOutcome::AlreadyPresent => report.already_present += 1,
263|                    ApplyOutcome::ConflictRefused { target_key } => {
264|                        // B2-1（P1-EV3 防劫持）：拒写响亮留痕，不静默丢 lesson
265|                        report.conflicts_refused += 1;
266|                        crate::audit_event!(
267|                            &app2,
268|                            crate::audit::AuditLevel::Warn,
269|                            "evolution.apply_conflict",
270|                            "proposal_id" => p.proposal_id.clone(),
271|                            "target_key" => target_key,
272|                            "action" => "lesson_write_refused_foreign_merge",
273|                        );
274|                    }
275|                }
276|            }
277|            Ok(report)
278|        })
279|        .await;
280|        match r {
281|            Ok(Ok(report)) if report.applied > 0 => {
282|                crate::bot::audit_log_hook(
283|                    &app,
284|                    &format!(
285|                        "evolution_apply | applied: {} | already_present: {}",
286|                        report.applied, report.already_present
287|                    ),
288|                );
289|            }
290|            Ok(Ok(_)) => {}
291|            Ok(Err(e)) => {
292|                crate::audit_event!(&app, crate::audit::AuditLevel::Warn, "evolution.apply_failed",
293|                    "error" => e);
294|            }
295|            Err(e) => {
296|                crate::audit_event!(&app, crate::audit::AuditLevel::Warn, "evolution.apply_failed",
297|                    "error" => format!("应用线程 join 失败：{e}"));
298|            }
299|        }
300|    });
301|
302|    // [R6 A] fire shadow（fire-and-forget；仅当 flag=true 时执行）
303|    if let Some(proposals_shadow) = shadow_proposals {
304|        let app_shadow = app_for_shadow;
305|        // 并发语义（老板 13:20 拍板后补）：
306|        // - app_for_shadow 是 Arc<Wry> 的克隆，廉价（reference count bump）
307|        // - 此 spawn 失败（panic）由 tauri::async_runtime 捕获，不传播到主 spawn
308|        // - 任务生命周期：spawn_blocking 不阻塞此 spawn；fire-and-forget 无超时（依赖外部观察）
309|        // - 共享状态：main spawn 用 proposals 引用，shadow spawn 用 proposals_shadow 克隆——无共享 mutation
310|        tauri::async_runtime::spawn(async move {
311|            crate::evolution::observe::shadow::shadow_apply_for_batch_with_app(
312|                proposals_shadow,
313|                &app_shadow,
314|            )
315|            .await;
316|        });
317|    }
318|}

330|        conn

334|        EvolutionProposal {
335|            proposal_id: id.into(),
336|            created_at_ms: 1_700_000_000_000,
337|            origin: ProposalOrigin::ConsolidationReflection,
338|            category: ProposalCategory::MemoryHint,
339|            target: ProposalTarget::MemoryPolicy {
340|                policy: "test".into(),
341|            },
342|            impact,
343|            evidence: Evidence {
344|                summary: format!("summary-{id}"),
345|                occurrence_count: 1,
346|                window_hours: 24,
347|                related_refs: vec![],
348|            },
349|            suggestion: Suggestion {

351|                structured_patch: None,

373|        assert!(!auto_apply_gate(&p));

460|    #[test]
461|    fn applied_proposal_records_active_change() {
462|        // B1-3（P0-EV2 另半）回归：apply 落 lesson 的同时补写 Active+AutoApplied
463|        // 的 ChangeRecord——面板 rollback 只读 changes.jsonl（load_changes →
464|        // change::read_all），缺这条则自动应用对回滚不可达（P0-EV2 的另一半）。
465|        // 构造走生产同一入口 auto_applied_from_proposal（合法流转达成 Active，
466|        // 不裸写 status），锁「写进去读得回、形态是面板回滚接受的样子」。
467|        let tmp = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();
468|        let path = tmp.path().join("evolution-changes.jsonl");
469|        let p = make_proposal("cr1", ImpactLevel::Medium);
470|        let cr = super::super::change::derive::auto_applied_from_proposal(&p, 1000)
471|            .expect("门槛内提案应可合法流转到 Active");
472|        super::super::change::append_change(&path, &cr).unwrap();
473|        let all = super::super::change::read_all(&path).unwrap();
474|        assert_eq!(all.len(), 1, "一条 apply 一条 CR");
475|        assert_eq!(all[0].proposal_id, "cr1");
476|        assert_eq!(all[0].change_id, "chg-cr1");
477|        assert_eq!(
478|            all[0].status,
479|            super::super::change::record::ChangeStatus::Active
480|        );
481|        assert_eq!(
482|            all[0].approval_source,
483|            super::super::change::record::ApprovalSource::AutoApplied
484|        );
485|        assert!(all[0].hard_constraint_compliance);
486|    }

491|        let p = make_proposal("low1", ImpactLevel::Low);
492|        assert!(
493|            super::super::change::derive::auto_applied_from_proposal(&p, 1000).is_err(),
494|            "Low 不过 auto_apply_gate，CR 构造应拒绝"

498|    // ─── B2-1（P1-EV3）幂等双保险 ───

28|/// jsonl 读取共享内核（OCR r2 medium 采纳：record/entry 两处 30 行 read_all 收敛
29|/// 单点防漂移）。语义（拍板 #17=C）：文件不存在 → Ok(空)；首个非空行损坏 = 结构级
30|/// 损坏 → Err（fail-closed）；中间坏行 → stderr 留痕跳过返回好行（已知代价：坏行 id
31|/// 缺失时 dedup 调用方可能同 id 再追加——无害重复）。
32|pub(crate) fn read_jsonl<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(
33|    path: &std::path::Path,
34|    label: &str,
35|) -> Result<Vec<T>, String> {
36|    use std::io::BufRead;
37|    if !path.exists() {
38|        return Ok(Vec::new());
39|    }
40|    let f = std::fs::File::open(path).map_err(|e| format!("打开 {path:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
41|    let reader = std::io::BufReader::new(f);
42|    let mut out = Vec::new();
43|    let mut first_parsed = false;
44|    for (i, line) in reader.lines().enumerate() {
45|        let line = line.map_err(|e| format!("读取第 {} 行失败：{e}", i + 1))?;
46|        if line.trim().is_empty() {
47|            continue;
48|        }
49|        match serde_json::from_str::<T>(&line) {
50|            Ok(v) => out.push(v),
51|            Err(e) if out.is_empty() && !first_parsed => {
52|                return Err(format!("第 1 行 JSON 错误：{e}"));
53|            }
54|            Err(e) => {
55|                eprintln!("[evolution] {label} jsonl 第 {} 行损坏已跳过：{e}", i + 1);
56|            }
57|        }
58|        first_parsed = true;
59|    }
60|    Ok(out)

72|/// evolution 存储（proposals + changes 两个 jsonl）的**进程内单锁**。
73|///
74|/// **一把锁覆盖两个文件是有意设计（OCR C3-4）**：toggle/delete 一次操作**同时**改两个文件，
75|/// 若按单文件各配一把锁，会出现「需要同时持两把锁」的顺序问题（死锁面）。
76|/// **改动时勿「优化」成按文件锁。**
77|/// 覆盖所有写路径：panel commands（toggle/delete/keep_shadow/rollback）+
78|/// post_consolidation 的 write_proposals。**entry/record 的 append/read_all
79|/// 内部不加锁**（外层已持锁，内层加锁必死锁）。
80|pub(crate) static EVOLUTION_STORE_LOCK: std::sync::Mutex<()> = std::sync::Mutex::new(());
81|
82|/// 取 evolution 存储锁（poison 走仓库既有 `[mutex_poisoned]` 约定）。
83|/// 临界区必须覆盖**完整 RMW 窗口**（load → mutate → rewrite），不是只锁 rewrite。
84|pub(crate) fn lock_evolution_store() -> std::sync::MutexGuard<'static, ()> {
85|    EVOLUTION_STORE_LOCK.lock().unwrap_or_else(|e| {
86|        eprintln!("[mutex_poisoned] evolution::EVOLUTION_STORE_LOCK: {e:?}");
87|        e.into_inner()
88|    })
89|}

94|/// emit 所需的 AppHandle 由 `emit::register_app_handle` 在 App 启动时注册一次，
95|/// 本函数通过全局 OnceLock 取出——consolidate 侧 caller 无需关心。
96|pub fn post_consolidation(ops: &[ConsolidateOp], report: &ConsolidateReport) {
97|    let proposals = derive::derive_proposals(ops, report);
98|    // Phase 2：emit（audit）之前先把达门槛的子集挑出来交给 apply——
99|    // emit 的 24h dedup 会吞掉重复提案，apply 侧靠 evo:<proposal_id> 持久幂等，
100|    // 两条去重链路互不影响。
101|    let gated: Vec<_> = proposals
102|        .iter()
103|        .filter(|p| apply::auto_apply_gate(p))
104|        .cloned()
105|        .collect();
106|
107|    // 补 R6 A 漏的连线（老板 12:29 拍板）：落盘候选池，让 shadow 钩子能读到。
108|    // dedup by proposal_id：跳过 24h 内已存在的。
109|    if let Some(app) = emit::app_handle() {
110|        // write_proposals 内部是 read_all→dedup→append 完整 RMW——必须整体
111|        // 持 store 锁（与 panel 的 toggle/rewrite 同一把，否则两套机制互踩）。
112|        // 锁只覆盖 write_proposals 本身；audit 写在锁外（不持锁跨磁盘 I/O）。
113|        let persist = {
114|            let _g = lock_evolution_store();
115|            candidate::write_proposals(app, &proposals)
116|        };
117|        match persist {
118|            Ok(n) if n > 0 => crate::audit_event!(
119|                app,
120|                crate::audit::AuditLevel::Info,
121|                "evolution.proposal.persisted",
122|                "count" => n.to_string(),
123|            ),
124|            Ok(_) => {}
125|            Err(e) => crate::audit_event!(
126|                app,
127|                crate::audit::AuditLevel::Warn,
128|                "evolution.proposal_persist_failed",
129|                "error" => e.clone(),
130|            ),
131|        }
132|    } else {
133|        // app_handle 未注册时整个落盘块被跳过——留痕不静默（audit_event! 需要
134|        // AppHandle，None 分支只能用 eprintln）。
135|        eprintln!(
136|            "[evolution] app_handle 未注册，候选池落盘跳过（{} 条 proposals）",
137|            proposals.len()
138|        );
139|    }
140|
141|    emit::emit_proposals(proposals);
142|    apply::apply_from_consolidation(gated);

43|/// 整体重写 jsonl（更新 status / TTL 用）。
44|/// 全量序列化后走 tmp+rename 原子落盘——truncate+逐行写在崩溃时留空/半截文件

46|fn rewrite_jsonl<T: serde::Serialize>(path: &PathBuf, entries: &[T]) -> Result<(), String> {
47|    use std::fmt::Write as _;
48|    if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
49|        std::fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|e| format!("建目录 {parent:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
50|    }
51|    let mut buf = String::new();
52|    for e in entries {
53|        let line = serde_json::to_string(e).map_err(|e| format!("序列化失败：{e}"))?;
54|        writeln!(buf, "{line}").map_err(|e| format!("拼接缓冲失败：{e}"))?;
55|    }
56|    crate::db::paths::atomic_write(path, &buf)

203|pub enum InsertOutcome {
204|    /// 新增成功
205|    Inserted(MemItem),
206|    /// 语义去重合并（余弦 ≥0.92）：刷新已有条目的 content/updated_at/access，未新增。
207|    /// orig_key = 被合并原条目的 tags[0]（item.tags 已被新值覆盖，提示文案要靠它指认原条目）
208|    Merged {
209|        item: MemItem,
210|        orig_key: Option<String>,
211|    },
212|    /// 容量满且无可淘汰条目 → 拒写
213|    RejectedFull(String),
214|    /// B2-1（P1-EV3 防记忆劫持）：带 `evo:` key 的 lesson 命中了**异 key** 的
215|    /// merge 目标（cosine ≥0.92）——merge-on-write 会把 lesson 内容+tags 覆盖到
216|    /// 既有记忆行（实证发生过行被劫持），此场景拒写不落库，由 apply 层记
217|    /// `evolution.apply_conflict` audit。target_key = 被拒绝合并的原行 key。
218|    RefusedForeignMerge { target_key: String },
219|}

222|pub struct NewItem {

224|    pub content: String,
225|    pub tags: Vec<String>,
226|    pub importance: i64,
227|    pub source: String,
228|}
229|
230|/// 写入（语义去重 + 容量淘汰）：
231|/// - embedding 为 Some 时先全表余弦去重：≥0.92 合并更新已有条目；0.75~0.92 仅记录为
232|///   冲突提示（返回值带出，不拦截）
233|/// - embedding 为 None（降级模式）跳过去重直接插入
234|/// 返回 (结果, 冲突提示列表[content 摘要])
235|pub fn insert_item(
236|    conn: &rusqlite::Connection,
237|    item: &NewItem,
238|    embedding: Option<&[f32]>,
239|    now_ms: i64,
240|) -> Result<(InsertOutcome, Vec<String>), String> {
241|    ensure_table(conn)?;
242|    let all = load_all(conn)?;
243|    // 语义去重（仅有向量时；降级模式无余弦可算，跳过）
244|    if let Some(emb) = embedding {
245|        let mut best: Option<(f64, &MemItem)> = None;
246|        let mut hints: Vec<(f64, &MemItem)> = Vec::new();
247|        for m in &all {
248|            if let Some(c) = cosine(Some(emb), m.embedding.as_deref()) {
249|                if c >= DEDUP_MERGE_COSINE {
250|                    if best.map_or(true, |(s, _)| c > s) {
251|                        best = Some((c, m));
252|                    }
253|                } else if c >= DEDUP_HINT_COSINE {
254|                    hints.push((c, m));
255|                }
256|            }
257|        }
258|        if let Some((_, target)) = best {
259|            // B2-1（P1-EV3）：lesson（evo: key）不许 merge 进异 key 既有行——
260|            // merge-on-write 是整行覆盖（content+tags 都换成 lesson 的），会把
261|            // 目标行劫持成 lesson、原记忆丢失。同 key = 本链路自己的重放，放行。
262|            let incoming_key = item.tags.first().cloned();
263|            let target_key = target.tags.first().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
264|            if incoming_key
265|                .as_deref()
266|                .map(|k| k.starts_with("evo:"))
267|                .unwrap_or(false)
268|                && target_key != incoming_key.unwrap_or_default()
269|            {
270|                return Ok((
271|                    InsertOutcome::RefusedForeignMerge {
272|                        target_key: target_key,
273|                    },
274|                    Vec::new(),
275|                ));
276|            }
277|            let orig_key = target.tags.first().cloned();
278|            conn.execute(
279|                "UPDATE mem_items SET content = ?1, tags = ?2, importance = ?3, source = ?4,
280|                        updated_at = ?5, access_count = access_count + 1, last_accessed_at = ?5,
281|                        embedding = ?6
282|                 WHERE id = ?7",
283|                rusqlite::params![
284|                    item.content,
285|                    item.tags.join(","),
286|                    item.importance.clamp(1, 5),
287|                    item.source,
288|                    ts_to_text(now_ms),
289|                    embedding_to_blob(emb),
290|                    target.id,
291|                ],
292|            )
293|            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
294|            let merged = MemItem {
295|                content: item.content.clone(),
296|                tags: item.tags.clone(),
297|                importance: item.importance.clamp(1, 5),
298|                source: item.source.clone(),
299|                updated_at_ms: now_ms,
300|                last_accessed_at_ms: Some(now_ms),
301|                access_count: target.access_count + 1,
302|                embedding: Some(emb.to_vec()),
303|                ..target.clone()
304|            };
305|            return Ok((
306|                InsertOutcome::Merged {
307|                    item: merged,
308|                    orig_key,
309|                },
310|                Vec::new(),
311|            ));
312|        }
313|        hints.sort_by(|a, b| b.0.partial_cmp(&a.0).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));
314|        let hint_texts: Vec<String> = hints
315|            .iter()
316|            .take(CONFLICT_HINT_TOP)
317|            .map(|(_, m)| {
318|                let key = m.tags.first().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
319|                if key.is_empty() {
320|                    m.content.chars().take(80).collect()
321|                } else {
322|                    format!(
323|                        "key={}, value={}",
324|                        key,
325|                        m.content.chars().take(80).collect::<String>()
326|                    )
327|                }
328|            })
329|            .collect();
330|        return insert_new(conn, item, embedding, now_ms).map(|outcome| (outcome, hint_texts));
331|    }
332|    insert_new(conn, item, embedding, now_ms).map(|outcome| (outcome, Vec::new()))
333|}

Good. So `store::insert_item` does load all items internally too. So the `apply_one` function loads all items once for the scan, then `insert_item` loads them again. This is the same data being loaded twice in one `apply_one` call. Confirmed finding #1 partially addresses this but the N+1 / double-load within a single call is worth noting more specifically. Let me look at the test for the third case more carefully to ensure correctness: In `apply_one_refuses_foreign_merge_and_preserves_target`: - Insert user item with embedding `[1.0, 0.0, 0.0]` and tags `["用户键"]` - Apply proposal with embedding `[1.0, 0.0, 0.0]` and tags `["evo:hij1", "evolution"]` In `apply_one`: - `key = "evo:hij1"` - Scan tags: `["用户键"]` - no match for `"evo:hij1"` - Scan content: `"用户既有记忆"` vs proposal text - won't match (need to check what proposal text is) - Then calls `insert_item` with embedding `[1.0, 0.0, 0.0]` - `insert_item` loads all, finds best cosine match with user item (cos=1.0 ≥ 0.92) - `incoming_key = Some("evo:hij1")` (starts with "evo:") - `target_key = "用户键"` (not equal to "evo:hij1") - → Returns `RefusedForeignMerge { target_key: "用户键" }` - → `apply_one` returns `ConflictRefused { target_key: "用户键" }` Good, the test should work. Now let me think about other potential issues: **Issue: Lock ordering concern** The comment in apply.rs says: ``` // 锁序：此处 DB_WRITE_LOCK 已释放才取本锁， // 与 panel（本锁内开 DB 连接）无环。 ``` But looking at panel commands.rs, the panel uses `lock_evolution_store()` around jsonl file operations. The panel doesn't open DB connections under any lock in the visible code. So the comment is misleading. Actually panel/commands.rs operates on jsonl files, not the SQLite DB. So there's no DB lock interaction here. But wait - what about `apply_from_consolidation` itself? It uses BOTH `DB_WRITE_LOCK` (inside the loop per-iteration) and `EVOLUTION_STORE_LOCK` (after the loop, for changes.jsonl). The comment says DB_WRITE_LOCK is released before EVOLUTION_STORE_LOCK is taken. Let me re-read: ```rust let outcome = { let _g = crate::db::DB_WRITE_LOCK.lock().unwrap_or_else(...); apply_one(&conn, p, emb.as_deref(), now)? }; // <-- DB_WRITE_LOCK released here (block ends) match outcome { ApplyOutcome::Applied => { ... match super::change::derive::auto_applied_from_proposal(p, now) { Ok(cr) => { let _store = super::lock_evolution_store(); // <-- takes EVOLUTION_STORE_LOCK if let Err(e) = super::change::append_change(&cr_path, &cr) { ... } } ... } ... } ... } ``` So the lock ordering is: DB_WRITE_LOCK → (released) → EVOLUTION_STORE_LOCK. This is fine in apply. But what about the reverse? Does any path do EVOLUTION_STORE_LOCK → DB_WRITE_LOCK? Let me check. Actually, panel commands don't acquire DB_WRITE_LOCK inside `lock_evolution_store()` blocks. So no reverse ordering. OK, no deadlock. But the comment is wrong about "panel (此锁内开 DB 连接)" - panel doesn't open DB connections. This is a documentation comment error. Let me also think about: **Issue: `apply_one` scans are now O(n²)** Already covered by finding #1 (well, finding #1 says O(n) for content + O(n·m) for tag-any, which is approximate). **Issue: Double load_all in apply_one** `apply_one` calls `store::load_all` for dedup, then `store::insert_item` internally calls `load_all` again for cosine dedup. This is double-loading. Not in confirmed findings. **Issue: Test ordering assumption** In `apply_one_refuses_foreign_merge_and_preserves_target`, the test inserts user item with content "用户既有记忆" first, then calls `apply_one`. In `apply_one`, it does a content scan for `kind == "lesson" && content == p.suggestion.text`. The user item has `kind="fact"`, so the content scan won't match. Good. Then `insert_item` is called which does the embedding-based dedup. But wait - what if the user item content happened to match the proposal text? The content scan could trigger before `insert_item` even gets a chance. That's actually the design intent - short-circuit the dedup. Now I need to think about what NEW issues remain. Let me review: 1. **Confirmed #1**: O(n) scans - covered. 2. **Confirmed #2**: Loss of Copy - covered. 3. **Confirmed #3**: Lock held across file I/O - covered. 4. **Confirmed #4**: Unnecessary `drop(all)` - covered. 5. **Confirmed #5**: Byte-equality swallows different proposals - covered. 6. **Confirmed #6**: No transactional guarantee - covered. Let me think about other potential issues not covered: **A. Double load_all in apply_one** `apply_one` calls `store::load_all` once, then `store::insert_item` calls `load_all` again. So for a single proposal, the entire memory table is loaded twice. For a batch of N proposals, it's loaded 2N times. This is wasteful. **B. `apply_one` ignores `embed_failed` warnings pre-existing** In the batch loop, `embed_failed` is checked once before the loop and audited. But individual `apply_one` calls don't surface this - the embedding passed in is `emb.as_deref()` which is `Option<&[f32]>`. When it's None, the cosine dedup is skipped, which means foreign merge is impossible (no embedding = no RefusedForeignMerge). So an embedding failure silently downgrades the security guarantee. **C. The comment in apply.rs saying "panel (此锁内开 DB 连接)" is **inaccurate** - panel doesn't open DB connections under EVOLUTION_STORE_LOCK. However, this is just a documentation comment issue. Let me think about whether this matters. Now let me consider: Is there any code path where `EVOLUTION_STORE_LOCK` is held while opening a DB connection? Let me check `apply_from_consolidation`: - DB connection opened BEFORE entering the per-iteration lock scope - EVOLUTION_STORE_LOCK acquired AFTER DB_WRITE_LOCK is released So apply's lock order is: open_db (no lock) → DB_WRITE_LOCK (per iter) → release → EVOLUTION_STORE_LOCK (after iter) Panel's lock order is: lock_evolution_store() → jsonl RMW → release (no DB connection opened under this lock) So the comment is wrong about panel opening DB under EVOLUTION_STORE_LOCK. +/// B2-4（P1-EV5）：行级唯一 change_id——基础 `chg-<pid>` 空闲则直接用；被占
+/// （上次启用已回滚/已过期）则 `-2`、`-3` 递增。同 id 双行是「二次回滚永久
+/// 卡死」的根因（rollback 按 id position() 首匹配）。
+fn next_unique_change_id(changes: &[ChangeRecord], proposal_id: &str) -> String {
+    let base = crate::evolution::change::derive_change_id(proposal_id);
+    let taken = |id: &str| changes.iter().any(|c| c.change_id == id);
+    if !taken(&base) {
+        return base;
+    }
+    for n in 2..=9999 {
+        let candidate = format!("{base}-{n}");
+        if !taken(&candidate) {
+            return candidate;
+        }
+    }
+    // 理论不可达兜底：时间戳后缀保证唯一
+    format!(
+        "{base}-{}",
+        chrono::Utc::now().timestamp_millis()
+    )
+}

32|pub(crate) fn read_jsonl<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(
33|    path: &std::path::Path,
34|    label: &str,
35|) -> Result<Vec<T>, String> {
36|    use std::io::BufRead;
37|    if !path.exists() {
38|        return Ok(Vec::new());
39|    }
40|    let f = std::fs::File::open(path).map_err(|e| format!("打开 {path:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
41|    let reader = std::io::BufReader::new(f);
42|    let mut out = Vec::new();
43|    let mut first_parsed = false;
44|    for (i, line) in reader.lines().enumerate() {
45|        let line = line.map_err(|e| format!("读取第 {} 行失败：{e}", i + 1))?;
46|        if line.trim().is_empty() {
47|            continue;
48|        }
49|        match serde_json::from_str::<T>(&line) {
50|            Ok(v) => out.push(v),
51|            Err(e) if out.is_empty() && !first_parsed => {
52|                return Err(format!("第 1 行 JSON 错误：{e}"));
53|            }
54|            Err(e) => {
55|                eprintln!("[evolution] {label} jsonl 第 {} 行损坏已跳过：{e}", i + 1);
56|            }
57|        }
58|        first_parsed = true;
59|    }
60|    Ok(out)

Now I have complete context: 1. **`read_jsonl` tolerates partial lines**: A corrupt line on row 2+ is silently skipped via `eprintln!`. Only the first row failure is fatal. So partial-line reads during concurrent writes won't crash, but they WILL silently drop rows — which means dedup may miss entries. 2. **`append` writes atomically**: `serde_json::to_string` + `line.push('\n')` + `write_all` of `line.as_bytes()`. Since `write_all` on a single line (typically <4KB = PIPE_BUF) is atomic at the filesystem level on Linux, and `read_jsonl` opens its own file handle, the reader can only see a line either fully or not at all (NOT a partial mid-write line). However, the read handler skips broken lines silently — if the read happens between writes and the line buffering causes a non-atomic view (e.g., reader's BufReader reads more bytes than one line from the kernel buffer before lines() parses), a partial line COULD be returned from `line()` and then fail to parse, resulting in silent skip. Actually wait — `lines()` in BufReader reads bytes until `\n`. If the OS atomicity guarantees hold (< PIPE_BUF write), then the reader can only see complete lines. The PIPE_BUF guarantee is for pipes though, not regular files. For regular files, `write_all` is generally not atomic at the kernel level above O_DIRECT/PIPE_BUF, but the typical Rust `write_all` of a small buffer to a file IS effectively atomic for small writes (single syscall, kernel page cache, etc.). In practice this is usually safe. Still, the safest design is to hold the lock during the read too. 3. **`lock_evolution_store`** is a single global `Mutex<()>`. Comment says: "临界区必须覆盖**完整 RMW 窗口**（load → mutate → rewrite），不是只锁 rewrite。" — explicitly stating the lock should cover read→mutate→write. The new `existing_open` read is OUTSIDE this contract — this is a contract violation. 4. **Trait versions in apply.rs use `from_proposal` and lock**: The apply path (`apply_from_consolidation`) does `lock_evolution_store()` + `append_change` correctly. But it doesn't have a dedup mechanism — it relies on `evolution_key` and the auto-apply gate. Looking at the diff, the trait `shadow_apply_for_batch` (without `with_app`) doesn't have dedup logic either. 5. **`append_change` is a thin wrapper**: Let me confirm this.

74|/// 9 态状态机
75|///
76|/// spec 硬约束 ②：必须 `Pending → Approved → Applied`，
77|/// 本状态机对 `Approved → Canary → Active` 显式建模每一步，

81|pub enum ChangeStatus {

83|    Pending,
84|    /// R3 影子测试中
85|    Shadowing,
86|    /// 影子通过，待批准
87|    ShadowPassed,
88|    /// 已批准（待 canary 或 active）
89|    Approved,
90|    /// R3 金丝雀（5%）
91|    Canary,
92|    /// 已全量生效
93|    Active,
94|    /// 拒绝（人工 / 系统 / 合规失败）
95|    Rejected,
96|    /// 已回滚
97|    RolledBack,
98|    /// 超期（TTL 14 天）
99|    Expired,
100|}

104|        match self {
105|            Self::Pending => "pending",

108|            Self::Approved => "approved",
109|            Self::Canary => "canary",

111|            Self::Rejected => "rejected",
112|            Self::RolledBack => "rolled_back",
113|            Self::Expired => "expired",

117|    /// 是否终态（不可再流转）
118|    ///

120|    /// 严格终态只有 Rejected / RolledBack / Expired（3 个）。
121|    pub fn is_terminal(self) -> bool {
122|        matches!(self, Self::Rejected | Self::RolledBack | Self::Expired)
123|    }

181|/// 追加一条 ChangeRecord 到 jsonl；保证父目录存在。
182|/// 整行单次 write_all（锁契约与残余风险同 candidate::entry::append 注释）。
183|pub fn append(path: &std::path::Path, record: &ChangeRecord) -> Result<(), String> {
184|    use std::io::Write;
185|    if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
186|        std::fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|e| format!("建目录 {parent:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
187|    }
188|    let mut f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
189|        .create(true)
190|        .append(true)
191|        .open(path)
192|        .map_err(|e| format!("打开 {path:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
193|    let mut line = serde_json::to_string(record).map_err(|e| format!("序列化失败：{e}"))?;
194|    line.push('\n');
195|    f.write_all(line.as_bytes())
196|        .map_err(|e| format!("写入 {path:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
197|    Ok(())
198|}

32|pub(crate) fn read_jsonl<T: serde::de::DeserializeOwned>(
33|    path: &std::path::Path,
34|    label: &str,
35|) -> Result<Vec<T>, String> {
36|    use std::io::BufRead;
37|    if !path.exists() {
38|        return Ok(Vec::new());
39|    }
40|    let f = std::fs::File::open(path).map_err(|e| format!("打开 {path:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
41|    let reader = std::io::BufReader::new(f);
42|    let mut out = Vec::new();
43|    let mut first_parsed = false;
44|    for (i, line) in reader.lines().enumerate() {
45|        let line = line.map_err(|e| format!("读取第 {} 行失败：{e}", i + 1))?;
46|        if line.trim().is_empty() {
47|            continue;
48|        }
49|        match serde_json::from_str::<T>(&line) {
50|            Ok(v) => out.push(v),
51|            Err(e) if out.is_empty() && !first_parsed => {
52|                return Err(format!("第 1 行 JSON 错误：{e}"));
53|            }
54|            Err(e) => {
55|                eprintln!("[evolution] {label} jsonl 第 {} 行损坏已跳过：{e}", i + 1);
56|            }
57|        }
58|        first_parsed = true;
59|    }
60|    Ok(out)

43|/// 整体重写 jsonl（更新 status / TTL 用）。
44|/// 全量序列化后走 tmp+rename 原子落盘——truncate+逐行写在崩溃时留空/半截文件
45|///（jsonl 是提案生命周期唯一持久化）。
46|fn rewrite_jsonl<T: serde::Serialize>(path: &PathBuf, entries: &[T]) -> Result<(), String> {
47|    use std::fmt::Write as _;
48|    if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
49|        std::fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|e| format!("建目录 {parent:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
50|    }
51|    let mut buf = String::new();
52|    for e in entries {
53|        let line = serde_json::to_string(e).map_err(|e| format!("序列化失败：{e}"))?;
54|        writeln!(buf, "{line}").map_err(|e| format!("拼接缓冲失败：{e}"))?;
55|    }
56|    crate::db::paths::atomic_write(path, &buf)
57|}

59|fn parse_status_filter(s: &str) -> Result<ProposalStatus, String> {
60|    match s {
61|        "pooled" => Ok(ProposalStatus::Pooled),
62|        "promoted" => Ok(ProposalStatus::Promoted),
63|        "expired" => Ok(ProposalStatus::Expired),
64|        "rejected" => Ok(ProposalStatus::Rejected),
65|        other => Err(format!("未知 ProposalStatus：{other}")),
66|    }
67|}

69|// ───────────────────────── Toggle / Delete（老板 16:05 拍板）─────────────────────────
70|//
71|// 老板设计语义：
72|// - toggle ON  → 写 ChangeRecord(status=pending)，dedup by proposal_id（已有 pending 不重写）
73|// - toggle OFF → 移除 ChangeRecord，proposal.status → Rejected
74|// - delete     → 删 proposals.jsonl 行 + 级联删 changes.jsonl 中 status=pending 行
75|//                （老板拍板：只允许删 Pending；active/rolled_back 用 Rollback）
76|// Promote/Reject 命令保留但语义改成 toggle ON/OFF（兼容老 UI/调用方）
77|
78|/// ON 返回 Some（锁内新写入或 dedup 命中的既有 ChangeRecord），OFF 返回 None。
79|/// promote 直接用返回值——**不要在锁外再 load_changes 找**（TOCTOU：并发
80|/// delete 会让锁外 find 落空，错误文案还会误导成「toggle_inner 写失败」）。
81|///
82|/// B2-4（拍板①）：已回滚提案允许再次 toggle ON（前端有回滚历史时先弹二次确认，
83|/// 见 EvolutionPanel onToggle）——新 CR 拿行级唯一 change_id（next_unique_change_id），
84|/// 回滚按 id 定位不再撞旧行。
85|fn toggle_inner(
86|    app: &AppHandle,
87|    proposal_id: &str,
88|    enabled: bool,
89|) -> Result<Option<ChangeRecord>, String> {
90|    let _g = lock_evolution_store(); // OCR C3-4：覆盖整个 load→mutate→rewrite 窗口
91|    let p_path = proposals_path(app);
92|    let c_path = changes_path(app);
93|
94|    let mut proposals = load_proposals(app)?;
95|    let idx = proposals
96|        .iter()
97|        .position(|e| e.proposal_id == proposal_id)
98|        .ok_or_else(|| format!("proposal {proposal_id} 不存在"))?;
99|    let mut entry = proposals[idx].clone();
100|
101|    let mut changes = load_changes(app)?;
102|
103|    if enabled {
104|        // Toggle ON：dedup（已有 pending/shadowing/shadow_passed 不重写）
105|        let existing = changes.iter().find(|c| {
106|            c.proposal_id == proposal_id
107|                && matches!(
108|                    c.status,
109|                    ChangeStatus::Pending | ChangeStatus::Shadowing | ChangeStatus::ShadowPassed
110|                )
111|        });
112|        let cr = match existing {
113|            Some(c) => {
114|                crate::audit_event!(
115|                    app,
116|                    AuditLevel::Info,
117|                    "evolution.toggle_on_dedup",
118|                    "proposal_id" => proposal_id.to_string(),
119|                );
120|                c.clone()
121|            }
122|            None => {
123|                let mut cr = candidate::to_change_record(&entry, true);
124|                cr.approval_source = ApprovalSource::HumanApproved;
125|                cr.human_approver = Some("boss".into());
126|                cr.status = ChangeStatus::Pending;
127|                // B2-4（P1-EV5）：复用 toggle（重启用）场景下基础 change_id 已被
128|                // 旧行占用——旧实现直接同 id 再 append，rollback 的 position() 首
129|                // 匹配永远命中旧行（二次回滚永久卡死）。改派生行级唯一 id：
130|                // chg-<pid> / chg-<pid>-2 / chg-<pid>-3 …
131|                cr.change_id = next_unique_change_id(&changes, proposal_id);
132|                change::append_change(&c_path, &cr)?;
133|                crate::audit_event!(
134|                    app,
135|                    AuditLevel::Info,
136|                    "evolution.toggle_on",
137|                    "proposal_id" => proposal_id.to_string(),
138|                    "change_id" => cr.change_id.clone(),
139|                );
140|                cr
141|            }
142|        };
143|        entry.status = ProposalStatus::Promoted;
144|        proposals[idx] = entry.clone();
145|        rewrite_jsonl(&p_path, &proposals)?;
146|        Ok(Some(cr))
147|    } else {
148|        // Toggle OFF：移除 pending ChangeRecord
149|        let before = changes.len();
150|        changes.retain(|c| !(c.proposal_id == proposal_id && c.status == ChangeStatus::Pending));
151|        if changes.len() == before {
152|            return Err(format!(
153|                "proposal {proposal_id} 没有 pending ChangeRecord，无法 toggle OFF"
154|            ));
155|        }
156|        rewrite_jsonl(&c_path, &changes)?;
157|        entry.status = ProposalStatus::Rejected;
158|        proposals[idx] = entry.clone();
159|        rewrite_jsonl(&p_path, &proposals)?;
160|        crate::audit_event!(
161|            app,
162|            AuditLevel::Warn,
163|            "evolution.toggle_off",
164|            "proposal_id" => proposal_id.to_string(),
165|        );
166|        Ok(None)
167|    }
168|}

170|/// B2-4（P1-EV5）：行级唯一 change_id——基础 `chg-<pid>` 空闲则直接用；被占
171|/// （上次启用已回滚/已过期）则 `-2`、`-3` 递增。同 id 双行是「二次回滚永久
172|/// 卡死」的根因（rollback 按 id position() 首匹配）。
173|fn next_unique_change_id(changes: &[ChangeRecord], proposal_id: &str) -> String {
174|    let base = crate::evolution::change::derive_change_id(proposal_id);
175|    let taken = |id: &str| changes.iter().any(|c| c.change_id == id);
176|    if !taken(&base) {
177|        return base;
178|    }
179|    for n in 2..=9999 {
180|        let candidate = format!("{base}-{n}");
181|        if !taken(&candidate) {
182|            return candidate;
183|        }
184|    }
185|    // 理论不可达兜底：时间戳后缀保证唯一
186|    format!(
187|        "{base}-{}",
188|        chrono::Utc::now().timestamp_millis()
189|    )
190|}
191|
192|fn delete_inner(app: &AppHandle, proposal_id: &str, cascade_source: bool) -> Result<(), String> {
193|    let _g = lock_evolution_store(); // OCR C3-4：覆盖整个 load→mutate→rewrite 窗口
194|    let p_path = proposals_path(app);
195|    let c_path = changes_path(app);
196|
197|    // 加载 proposal entry（拿 related_refs，cascade 时用）
198|    let proposals = load_proposals(app)?;
199|    let entry = proposals
200|        .iter()
201|        .find(|e| e.proposal_id == proposal_id)
202|        .ok_or_else(|| format!("proposal {proposal_id} 不存在"))?
203|        .clone();
204|    let related_refs = entry.related_refs.clone();
205|
206|    // 1. 删 proposals.jsonl 行（废案：下次 consolidation / LLM 也不会执行）
207|    let mut proposals = proposals;
208|    proposals.retain(|e| e.proposal_id != proposal_id);
209|    rewrite_jsonl(&p_path, &proposals)?;
210|
211|    // 2. 级联删 changes.jsonl：仅删 status=pending（其他状态走 Rollback）
212|    let mut changes = load_changes(app)?;
213|    let before = changes.len();
214|    changes.retain(|c| !(c.proposal_id == proposal_id && c.status == ChangeStatus::Pending));
215|    let cascaded = before - changes.len();
216|    rewrite_jsonl(&c_path, &changes)?;
217|
218|    // 3. 可选 cascade 源记忆（老板 16:35 拍板：默认关，复选框选）
219|    let mut mem_deleted = 0usize;
220|    if cascade_source {
221|        let conn = crate::db::open_db(app)?;
222|        mem_deleted = cascade_delete_mem_items(&conn, &related_refs, &proposal_id)?;
223|    }
224|
225|    crate::audit_event!(
226|        app,
227|        AuditLevel::Warn,
228|        "evolution.delete",
229|        "proposal_id" => proposal_id.to_string(),
230|        "cascaded_changes" => cascaded.to_string(),
231|        "cascaded_mem_items" => mem_deleted.to_string(),
232|        "cascade_source" => cascade_source.to_string(),
233|    );
234|    Ok(())
235|}
236|
237|/// B1-2（P0-EV2 半）：cascade_source 的记忆级联内核（注入连接，内存库可单测）——
238|/// related_refs 源记忆整删 + apply 落下的 lesson 按 key_tag（evo:<id>）删。
239|/// 只删 related_refs 会把废案提案的 lesson 留成孤儿（injection_block 永带出）。
240|pub(crate) fn cascade_delete_mem_items(
241|    conn: &rusqlite::Connection,
242|    related_refs: &[String],
243|    proposal_id: &str,
244|) -> Result<usize, String> {
245|    let mut n = if related_refs.is_empty() {
246|        0
247|    } else {
248|        crate::memory::store::delete_by_ids(conn, related_refs)?
249|    };
250|    if crate::evolution::apply::rollback_applied(conn, proposal_id)? {
251|        n += 1;
252|    }
253|    Ok(n)
254|}

516|/// 回滚前置校验（无锁快照与锁内复检共用，避免两处语义漂移）。
517|fn rollback_precheck(record: &ChangeRecord, change_id: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
518|    if record.status == ChangeStatus::RolledBack {
519|        return Err(format!("change {change_id} 已回滚"));
520|    }
521|    if record.status.is_terminal() && record.status != ChangeStatus::Active {
522|        return Err(format!(
523|            "change {change_id} 状态 {:?} 不可回滚",
524|            record.status
525|        ));
526|    }
527|    Ok(())
528|}
529|
530|/// 回滚的 RMW 部分（**同步**、持 store 锁）：load → 校验 → 删 mem_item → 改状态 → rewrite。
531|/// 不含 `await` —— 故可安全被 async command 调用（锁不跨 await，future 保持 Send）。
532|fn rollback_change_locked(app: &AppHandle, change_id: &str) -> Result<ChangeRecord, String> {
533|    let _g = lock_evolution_store(); // OCR C3-4：覆盖整个 load→mutate→rewrite 窗口
534|    let path = changes_path(app);
535|    let mut records = load_changes(app)?;
536|
537|    let idx = records
538|        .iter()
539|        .position(|r| r.change_id == change_id)
540|        .ok_or_else(|| format!("change {change_id} 不存在"))?;
541|    let record = records[idx].clone();
542|    rollback_precheck(&record, change_id)?;
543|
544|    // 删除 mem_item（走 db 连接）
545|    delete_evolution_mem_item(app, &record.proposal_id)?;
546|
547|    // 状态 → RolledBack + 写回 jsonl
548|    let mut updated = record.clone();
549|    updated.status = ChangeStatus::RolledBack;
550|    updated.rolled_back_at = Some(chrono::Utc::now().timestamp_millis());
551|    updated.rollback_reason = Some("human_rollback_via_panel".into());
552|    records[idx] = updated.clone();
553|    rewrite_jsonl(&path, &records)?;
554|    Ok(updated)
555|}
556|
557|/// 删除 evolution mem_item（tags[0] = "evo:<proposal_id>"）
558|///
559|/// 通过 store::delete_by_key_tag 实现。
560|/// 错误不阻塞回滚（mem_item 可能已不存在，例如重启后丢失）。
561|fn delete_evolution_mem_item(app: &AppHandle, proposal_id: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
562|    use crate::db;
563|    let key = format!("evo:{proposal_id}");
564|    let conn = db::open_db(app).map_err(|e| format!("打开 DB 失败：{e}"))?;
565|    let deleted = crate::memory::store::delete_by_key_tag(&conn, &key)
566|        .map_err(|e| format!("删除 mem_item 失败：{e}"))?;
567|    if !deleted {
568|        eprintln!("[evolution] rollback: mem_item {key} 不存在（可能已淘汰）");
569|    }
570|    Ok(())
571|}

34|///（旧名让调用方按名字推断成全合规，可能跳过下游复核）。
35|/// impact 用显式白名单（High | Medium）：未来新增变体必须显式 opt-in。
36|pub fn passes_auto_apply_gate(p: &EvolutionProposal) -> bool {
37|    matches!(p.category, ProposalCategory::MemoryHint)
38|        && matches!(p.impact, ImpactLevel::High | ImpactLevel::Medium)
39|}
40|
41|/// layer 从 category 派生（DERIVABILITY.md 字段 1，部分覆盖）
42|///
43|/// 4/6 层映射；Parameter / Code 两层当前无 category 对应，
44|/// R4/R8 触发后再扩展。
45|pub fn derive_layer(category: ProposalCategory) -> EvolutionLayer {
46|    match category {
47|        ProposalCategory::MemoryHint => EvolutionLayer::Policy,
48|        ProposalCategory::PromptHint => EvolutionLayer::PromptHint,
49|        ProposalCategory::ToolSchemaHint => EvolutionLayer::ToolSchema,
50|        ProposalCategory::SkillHint => EvolutionLayer::Skill,
51|    }
52|}
53|
54|/// 从 EvolutionProposal 构造 ChangeRecord
55|///
56|/// 初始 status 由 compliance 决定：
57|/// - compliance=true  → Pending（待沙箱或批准）
58|/// - compliance=false → Rejected（SystemRejected）
59|pub fn from_proposal(p: &EvolutionProposal, now_ms: i64) -> ChangeRecord {
60|    let compliance = passes_auto_apply_gate(p);
61|    let (status, approval_source) = if compliance {
62|        (ChangeStatus::Pending, ApprovalSource::Pending)
63|    } else {
64|        (ChangeStatus::Rejected, ApprovalSource::SystemRejected)
65|    };
66|    ChangeRecord {
67|        change_id: derive_change_id(&p.proposal_id),
68|        parent_id: None, // 根节点；迭代版本后续设
69|        schema_version: DEFAULT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
70|        layer: derive_layer(p.category),
71|        origin: p.origin,
72|        proposal_id: p.proposal_id.clone(),
73|        target: p.target.clone(),
74|        suggestion_text: p.suggestion.text.clone(),
75|        mem_key: derive_mem_key(&p.proposal_id),
76|        impact: p.impact,
77|        eval_before: None,
78|        eval_after: None,
79|        status,
80|        hard_constraint_compliance: compliance,
81|        approval_source,
82|        human_approver: None,
83|        created_at_ms: now_ms,
84|        rolled_back_at: None,
85|        rollback_reason: None,
86|    }
87|}
88|
89|/// B1-3：自动应用路径的 CR 构造（生产 apply 与回归测试共用，锁「Active +
90|/// AutoApplied 经合法流转达成」这一不变量）。
91|///
92|/// 自动应用（MemoryHint lesson 直写记忆）不经沙箱/影子——那是整改流水线的
93|/// 门，不是 lesson 路径的门——但 CR 形态仍走满合法流转
94|///（Pending → Shadowing → ShadowPassed → Approved → Active，中间态瞬时通过），
95|/// 不裸写 status 绕状态机（Pending → Active 直跳被 status.rs 硬约束②显式拦截，
96|/// 评审 HIGH）。入口提案须已过 auto_apply_gate（compliance=false 的
97|/// from_proposal 是终态 Rejected，流转即 Err）。
98|pub fn auto_applied_from_proposal(
99|    p: &EvolutionProposal,
100|    now_ms: i64,
101|) -> Result<ChangeRecord, String> {
102|    let mut cr = from_proposal(p, now_ms);
103|    use ChangeStatus::{Active, Approved, ShadowPassed, Shadowing};
104|    for step in [Shadowing, ShadowPassed, Approved, Active] {
105|        super::status::transition(cr.status, step)?;
106|        cr.status = step;
107|    }
108|    cr.approval_source = ApprovalSource::AutoApplied;
109|    cr.hard_constraint_compliance = true;
110|    Ok(cr)
111|}

92|    /// 已全量生效

94|    /// 拒绝（人工 / 系统 / 合规失败）
95|    Rejected,

98|    /// 超期（TTL 14 天）
99|    Expired,
100|}

103|    pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
104|        match self {
105|            Self::Pending => "pending",
106|            Self::Shadowing => "shadowing",
107|            Self::ShadowPassed => "shadow_passed",
108|            Self::Approved => "approved",
109|            Self::Canary => "canary",
110|            Self::Active => "active",
111|            Self::Rejected => "rejected",
112|            Self::RolledBack => "rolled_back",
113|            Self::Expired => "expired",
114|        }
115|    }

120|    /// 严格终态只有 Rejected / RolledBack / Expired（3 个）。
121|    pub fn is_terminal(self) -> bool {
122|        matches!(self, Self::Rejected | Self::RolledBack | Self::Expired)
123|    }

179|// ───────────────────────── jsonl IO ─────────────────────────
180|
181|/// 追加一条 ChangeRecord 到 jsonl；保证父目录存在。
182|/// 整行单次 write_all（锁契约与残余风险同 candidate::entry::append 注释）。
183|pub fn append(path: &std::path::Path, record: &ChangeRecord) -> Result<(), String> {
184|    use std::io::Write;
185|    if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
186|        std::fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|e| format!("建目录 {parent:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
187|    }
188|    let mut f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()
189|        .create(true)
190|        .append(true)
191|        .open(path)
192|        .map_err(|e| format!("打开 {path:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
193|    let mut line = serde_json::to_string(record).map_err(|e| format!("序列化失败：{e}"))?;
194|    line.push('\n');
195|    f.write_all(line.as_bytes())
196|        .map_err(|e| format!("写入 {path:?} 失败：{e}"))?;
197|    Ok(())
198|}
199|
200|/// 读全部 ChangeRecord；缺文件返空 vec
201|pub fn read_all(path: &std::path::Path) -> Result<Vec<ChangeRecord>, String> {
202|    crate::evolution::read_jsonl(path, "changes")
203|}
204|
205|/// 按 change_id 查询；返回 (record, index) 或 None
206|pub fn find_by_id<'a>(
207|    records: &'a [ChangeRecord],
208|    change_id: &str,
209|) -> Option<(usize, &'a ChangeRecord)> {
210|    records
211|        .iter()
212|        .enumerate()
213|        .find(|(_, r)| r.change_id == change_id)
214|}
215|
216|/// 按 parent_id 查询子代
217|pub fn find_children<'a>(records: &'a [ChangeRecord], parent_id: &str) -> Vec<&'a ChangeRecord> {
218|    records
219|        .iter()
220|        .filter(|r| r.parent_id.as_deref() == Some(parent_id))
221|        .collect()
222|}
223|
224|/// 根记录（parent_id = None）
225|pub fn find_roots(records: &[ChangeRecord]) -> Vec<&ChangeRecord> {
226|    records.iter().filter(|r| r.parent_id.is_none()).collect()
227|}

1|//! R4 L1 候选层 · ProposalEntry → ChangeRecord 映射
2|//!
3|//! spec R4：ProposalStatus ↔ ChangeStatus 映射
4|//! 映射规则：
5|//! - Pooled / Promoted → ChangeStatus::Pending
6|//! - Expired → ChangeStatus::Expired
7|//! - Rejected → ChangeStatus::Rejected
8|
9|use super::entry::{ProposalEntry, ProposalStatus};
10|use crate::evolution::change::{
11|    ApprovalSource, ChangeRecord, ChangeStatus, DEFAULT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
12|};
13|
14|/// ProposalStatus → ChangeStatus 映射
15|pub fn map_proposal_status_to_change_status(s: ProposalStatus) -> ChangeStatus {
16|    match s {
17|        ProposalStatus::Pooled => ChangeStatus::Pending,
18|        ProposalStatus::Promoted => ChangeStatus::Pending,
19|        ProposalStatus::Expired => ChangeStatus::Expired,
20|        ProposalStatus::Rejected => ChangeStatus::Rejected,
21|    }
22|}
23|
24|/// 从 ProposalEntry 派生 ChangeRecord
25|///
26|/// 注意：approval_source 取决于合规检查与 resolved status（两者一起派生，
27|/// 避免「status=Rejected 却 approval_source=Pending」的内部不一致）。
28|/// Expired 保持 Pending：ApprovalSource 无 Expired 对应变体（从未批准也未被拒）。
29|pub fn to_change_record(entry: &ProposalEntry, hard_constraint_compliance: bool) -> ChangeRecord {
30|    let status = if !hard_constraint_compliance {
31|        ChangeStatus::Rejected
32|    } else {
33|        map_proposal_status_to_change_status(entry.status)
34|    };
35|    // approval_source 与 status 一起派生：不合规/被拒 → SystemRejected，
36|    // 其余 → Pending（不合规时 status 已被压成 Rejected，走同一分支）。
37|    let approval_source = match status {
38|        ChangeStatus::Rejected => ApprovalSource::SystemRejected,
39|        _ => ApprovalSource::Pending,
40|    };
41|    ChangeRecord {
42|        change_id: entry.change_id.clone(),
43|        parent_id: None, // 根
44|        schema_version: DEFAULT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
45|        layer: entry.layer,
46|        origin: entry.origin,
47|        proposal_id: entry.proposal_id.clone(),
48|        target: entry.target.clone(),
49|        suggestion_text: entry.suggestion_text.clone(),
50|        mem_key: entry.mem_key.clone(),
51|        impact: entry.impact,
52|        eval_before: None,
53|        eval_after: None,
54|        status,
55|        hard_constraint_compliance,
56|        approval_source,
57|        human_approver: None,
58|        created_at_ms: entry.created_at_ms,
59|        rolled_back_at: None,
60|        rollback_reason: None,
61|    }

1|//! R6 A · Shadow observe —— 与主 apply 并行

3|//! ## 设计修正（老板 13:20 审阅后）

7|//! - 生产：`AppShadowSink` 包 `AppHandle`，写 evolution-changes.jsonl + 发 audit
8|//! - 测试：`MockShadowSink` 内存收集所有调用，验证「不写 X」「不发 Y」
9|//!
10|//! 4 个核心 e2e 测试（用 MockSink）：
11|//! 1. shadow_apply 真的被调用 → spy 通过 mock sink.writes() 验证
12|//! 2. shadow_apply 真的写 evolution-changes.jsonl → AppShadowSink 写真实 temp 文件
13|//! 3. shadow_apply 后 mem_items 未变 → 用 in-memory SQLite 对照
14|//! 4. shadow_apply 后 audit 未新增（正常路径）→ mock sink.audit_failed/warning 验证空
15|//!
16|//! 老板纪律（2026-09-18 13:13/13:20 拍板）：
17|//! - feature flag `evolution.shadow.enabled`，默认 false
18|//! - 不写 mem_items / 只写 evolution-changes.jsonl / 不发 audit.proposal

77|    }

173|// ───────────────────────── 主入口（trait 化）─────────────────────────

175|/// Shadow 执行报告
176|#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
177|pub struct ShadowReport {
178|    pub total: usize,
179|    pub written: usize,
180|    pub failed: usize,
181|    /// B2-3：同 proposal_id 已有未终态 CR 而跳过的条数（去重命中）
182|    pub deduped: usize,
183|}
184|
185|/// 跑一轮 shadow apply
186|///
187|/// **核心保证**（由 trait 边界保证，e2e 测试验证）：
188|/// - 不写 mem_items（trait 没暴露 mem_items 接口）
189|/// - 正常路径不发 audit（除非写失败 / 失败率 > 阈值）
190|/// - 失败仅 audit_event + 原子计数
191|///
192|/// **调用约束**：当前零生产调用方，仅测试 + MockShadowSink（内存 sink，
193|/// 无真实 IO）。sink.write_change 是同步调用——若未来接真实 fs sink
194|/// 上生产 async 路径，须先把写路径 spawn_blocking 化（参考 with_app）。
195|pub async fn shadow_apply_for_batch<S: ShadowSink>(
196|    proposals: Vec<EvolutionProposal>,
197|    sink: &S,
198|) -> ShadowReport {
199|    let gated: Vec<EvolutionProposal> = proposals
200|        .into_iter()
201|        .filter(|p| auto_apply_gate(p))
202|        .collect();
203|
204|    let mut written = 0usize;
205|    let mut failed = 0usize;
206|    let now = sink.now_ms();
207|
208|    for p in &gated {
209|        let cr: ChangeRecord = change::from_proposal(p, now);
210|        match sink.write_change(&cr) {
211|            Ok(()) => {
212|                written += 1;
213|                TOTAL_WRITES.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
214|            }
215|            Err(e) => {
216|                failed += 1;
217|                TOTAL_WRITES.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
218|                FAILED_WRITES.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
219|                sink.audit_failed(&p.proposal_id, &e);
220|            }
221|        }
222|    }
223|
224|    let total = TOTAL_WRITES.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
225|    let failed_count = FAILED_WRITES.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
226|    if total > 0 && (failed_count as f64 / total as f64) > FAILURE_THRESHOLD {
227|        sink.audit_warning(failed_count as f64 / total as f64, failed_count, total);
228|    }
229|
230|    ShadowReport {
231|        total: gated.len(),
232|        written,
233|        failed,
234|        deduped: 0,
235|    }
236|}

299|/// 便捷包装（apply.rs 调用入口；R7→A→B 后唯一对外入口）
300|///
301|/// 流程（B 阶段，v4.1 §12.7 + B 校准前置）：
302|/// 1. 过 auto_apply_gate（合规性）
303|/// 2. 过 is_reversible（可逆性）
304|/// 3. 读 activation_state（bot-config.json）
305|/// 4. 按状态路由：
306|///    - S0/S1：不调 evaluate，写 shadow jsonl + audit no_policy_applied
307|///    - S2：调 evaluate_s2（占位=is_reversible反向）→ Allow 写 shadow + audit allowed；Block 跳过 + audit blocked
308|/// 5. 不可逆的 proposal：audit not_reversible + 跳过
309|pub async fn shadow_apply_for_batch_with_app(
310|    proposals: Vec<EvolutionProposal>,
311|    app: &AppHandle,
312|) -> ShadowReport {
313|    use crate::evolution::activation::{evaluate_s2, S2Decision};
314|
315|    let gated: Vec<EvolutionProposal> = proposals
316|        .into_iter()
317|        .filter(|p| auto_apply_gate(p))
318|        .collect();
319|    let config_path = paths::data_dir(app).join("bot-config.json");
320|    let state = crate::evolution::activation::load_state_from_file(&config_path);
321|    let path = paths::data_dir(app).join("evolution-changes.jsonl");
322|    // B2-3（P1-EV4）：先读一次存量 CR——同 proposal_id 已有未终态行
323|    //（Pending/Shadowing/ShadowPassed，含 panel toggle ON 写的）→ 本轮跳过
324|    // append，不再无条件重复追加 Pending 行（实证同 id 多行 Pending）
325|    let existing_open: std::collections::HashSet<String> = {
326|        let path = path.clone();
327|        tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || {
328|            match crate::evolution::change::read_all(&path) {
329|                Ok(rows) => rows
330|                    .into_iter()
331|                    .filter(|c| {
332|                        matches!(
333|                            c.status,
334|                            ChangeStatus::Pending
335|                                | ChangeStatus::Shadowing
336|                                | ChangeStatus::ShadowPassed
337|                        )
338|                    })
339|                    .map(|c| c.proposal_id)
340|                    .collect(),
341|                Err(_) => std::collections::HashSet::new(),
342|            }
343|        })
344|        .await
345|        .unwrap_or_default()
346|    };
347|    let mut written = 0usize;
348|    let mut failed = 0usize;
349|    let mut deduped = 0usize;
350|    let now = crate::memory::now_ms();
351|
352|    for p in &gated {
353|        if !is_reversible(p) {
354|            crate::audit_event!(
355|                app,
356|                AuditLevel::Info,
357|                "evolution.not_reversible",
358|                "proposal_id" => p.proposal_id.clone(),
359|                "category" => format!("{:?}", p.category),
360|                "impact" => p.impact.as_str(),
361|            );
362|            continue;
363|        }
364|        // B2-3 去重命中：跳过（info 留痕，非失败不计入告警分母）
365|        if existing_open.contains(&p.proposal_id) {
366|            deduped += 1;
367|            crate::audit_event!(
368|                app,
369|                AuditLevel::Info,
370|                "evolution.shadow_dedup_hit",
371|                "proposal_id" => p.proposal_id.clone(),
372|            );
373|            continue;
374|        }
375|        // S2 调 evaluate（占位=is_reversible 反向）；S0/S1 不调 evaluate
376|        let s2_decision = match state {
377|            ActivationState::S2Active => Some(evaluate_s2(p)),
378|            _ => None,
379|        };
380|        // Block 决策：跳过 + audit
381|        if let Some(S2Decision::Block { reason }) = &s2_decision {
382|            crate::audit_event!(
383|                app,
384|                AuditLevel::Info,
385|                "evolution.blocked",
386|                "state" => state.as_str(),
387|                "proposal_id" => p.proposal_id.clone(),
388|                "reason" => reason.clone(),
389|                "policy_version" => "calibrating",
390|            );
391|            continue;
392|        }
393|        // Allow 决策或 S0/S1：写 shadow + audit
394|        let cr = change::from_proposal(p, now);
395|        // append_change 是阻塞 fs IO（open+writeln syscall）——包 spawn_blocking
396|        // 避免钉住 tokio worker（本 fn 是生产唯一入口，跑在 Tauri async runtime 上）；
397|        // B2-2（P1-EV4）：写走 EVOLUTION_STORE_LOCK（锁在阻塞闭包内取，不跨 await）
398|        // ——与 panel RMW/apply 补写同一把单写者锁，不再绕锁并发写 changes.jsonl
399|        let write_result = {
400|            let path = path.clone();
401|            // cr 本轮迭代仅此处消费，直接 move（不 clone）
402|            match tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking(move || {
403|                let _store = crate::evolution::lock_evolution_store();
404|                change::append_change(&path, &cr)
405|            })
406|            .await
407|            {
408|                Ok(r) => r,
409|                // tauri::Error（非 tokio JoinError）无 is_panic/into_panic——
410|                // Display 已带 panic payload 信息，直接透传
411|                Err(e) => Err(format!("shadow 写线程 join 失败：{e}")),
412|            }
413|        };
414|        match write_result {
415|            Ok(()) => {
416|                written += 1;
417|                // 与 trait 变体一致的计数器增量——本入口是生产路径，
418|                // 不碰原子计数器会让「失败率 >5% 告警」对生产流量永不触发
419|                TOTAL_WRITES.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
420|                match (state, &s2_decision) {
421|                    (ActivationState::S0Observe, _) | (ActivationState::S1Suggest, _) => {
422|                        crate::audit_event!(
423|                            app,
424|                            AuditLevel::Info,
425|                            "evolution.no_policy_applied",
426|                            "state" => state.as_str(),
427|                            "proposal_id" => p.proposal_id.clone(),
428|                            "category" => format!("{:?}", p.category),
429|                            "impact" => p.impact.as_str(),
430|                        );
431|                    }
432|                    (ActivationState::S2Active, Some(S2Decision::Allow { reason })) => {
433|                        crate::audit_event!(
434|                            app,
435|                            AuditLevel::Info,
436|                            "evolution.allowed",
437|                            "state" => state.as_str(),
438|                            "proposal_id" => p.proposal_id.clone(),
439|                            "reason" => reason.clone(),
440|                            "policy_version" => "calibrating",
441|                        );
442|                    }
443|                    _ => {} // 不可达（state+S2Decision 组合穷尽）
444|                }
445|            }
446|            Err(e) => {
447|                failed += 1;
448|                TOTAL_WRITES.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
449|                FAILED_WRITES.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
450|                crate::audit_event!(
451|                    app,
452|                    AuditLevel::Warn,
453|                    "evolution.shadow_failed",
454|                    "proposal_id" => p.proposal_id.clone(),
455|                    "error" => e.clone(),
456|                );
457|            }
458|        }
459|    }
460|    // B2-5（P1-EV6）：生产入口补失败率告警，对齐 trait 版（sink.audit_warning）——
461|    // 此前生产流量写失败 >5% 永不告警（只有 trait 路径有）
462|    let total = TOTAL_WRITES.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
463|    let failed_count = FAILED_WRITES.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
464|    if total > 0 && (failed_count as f64 / total as f64) > FAILURE_THRESHOLD {
465|        crate::audit_event!(
466|            app,
467|            AuditLevel::Warn,
468|            "evolution.shadow_warning",
469|            "failure_rate" => failed_count as f64 / total as f64,
470|            "failed" => failed_count,
471|            "total" => total,
472|            "threshold" => FAILURE_THRESHOLD,
473|        );
474|    }
475|    ShadowReport {
476|        total: gated.len(),
477|        written,
478|        failed,
479|        deduped: 0,
480|    }
481|}

732|    /// E2E pre-flight（决策 6）：shadow 跑合成数据，与「apply 理论应写数」对比，
733|    /// 差异率 < 60% 才能开 flag。
734|    ///
735|    /// 老板 13:20 拍板：「一致性校验从 post-process 预留改为跑前合成数据校验」。
736|    /// 即：dev 启用 flag 之前必须先跑这个测试通过，否则禁止开 flag
737|    /// （shadow 与 apply 行为不一致是设计 bug）。
738|    #[tokio::test]
739|    async fn e2e_preflight_shadow_consistency_with_mixed_proposals() {
740|        let _g = counter_lock();
741|        reset_counters_for_test();
742|
743|        // 50 条 proposal：80% 合规 + 20% 不合规（直接 mk_proposal，不依赖 synthetic 模块）
744|        let proposals: Vec<EvolutionProposal> = (0..50)
745|            .map(|i| {
746|                if i % 5 == 0 {
747|                    // 不合规：PromptHint + High
748|                    mk_proposal(
749|                        &format!("nc{i}"),
750|                        ProposalCategory::PromptHint,
751|                        ImpactLevel::High,
752|                    )
753|                } else if i % 2 == 0 {
754|                    // 合规 + High
755|                    mk_proposal(
756|                        &format!("p{i}"),
757|                        ProposalCategory::MemoryHint,
758|                        ImpactLevel::High,
759|                    )
760|                } else {
761|                    // 合规 + Medium
762|                    mk_proposal(
763|                        &format!("p{i}"),
764|                        ProposalCategory::MemoryHint,
765|                        ImpactLevel::Medium,
766|                    )
767|                }
768|            })
769|            .collect();
770|
771|        // apply 理论应写数 = 过 auto_apply_gate 的 proposal 数
772|        let apply_expected_count = proposals.iter().filter(|p| auto_apply_gate(p)).count();
773|        assert!(apply_expected_count > 0, "至少要有 1 条合规 proposal");
774|
775|        // shadow 跑同一批 proposal
776|        let sink = MockShadowSink::new();
777|        let report = shadow_apply_for_batch(proposals, &sink).await;
778|
779|        // 差异率
780|        let diff = (report.written as i64 - apply_expected_count as i64).abs();
781|        let diff_rate = if apply_expected_count > 0 {
782|            diff as f64 / apply_expected_count as f64
783|        } else {
784|            0.0
785|        };
786|
787|        // 验证：差异率 < 60%（决策 d 阈值；老板 13:20 拍板）
788|        assert!(
789|            diff_rate < 0.60,
790|            "shadow.written={} vs apply_expected={} 差异率 {:.1}% ≥ 60%，禁止开 flag",
791|            report.written,
792|            apply_expected_count,
793|            diff_rate * 100.0
794|        );
795|        // mock sink 也验证收到写入
796|        assert!(sink.write_count() > 0, "mock sink 应收到 shadow 写入");
797|        assert_eq!(sink.write_count(), report.written);
798|        assert_eq!(sink.audit_failed_count(), 0, "正常路径不应发 audit_failed");
799|        assert_eq!(sink.audit_warning_count(), 0, "失败率未超阈值");
800|    }

843|    fn changes_jsonl_appends_survive_concurrent_writers() {
844|        // B2-2（P1-EV4）：changes.jsonl 三写者（shadow/panel/apply）收敛到
845|        // EVOLUTION_STORE_LOCK——并发 append 一行不少、change_id 无碰撞

847|        let dir = tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();

849|        let mut handles = Vec::new();
850|        for t in 0..4 {
851|            let file = path.clone();
852|            handles.push(std::thread::spawn(move || {
853|                for i in 0..25 {
854|                    let prop = mk_proposal(
855|                        &format!("w{t}-{i}"),
856|                        ProposalCategory::MemoryHint,
857|                        ImpactLevel::Medium,
858|                    );
859|                    let cr = change::from_proposal(&prop, 1000);
860|                    let _g = crate::evolution::lock_evolution_store();

862|                }
863|            }));
864|        }
865|        for h in handles {
866|            h.join().unwrap();

872|        let before = ids.len();
873|        ids.dedup();
874|        assert_eq!(ids.len(), before, "change_id 两两不同（每行独立提案）");

Confirmed: `from_proposal` uses `derive_change_id(proposal_id)` which produces `chg-<pid>`. This collides with the old rolled-back CR for re-enabled proposals. Now let me also check `auto_applied_from_proposal`: This uses `from_proposal` internally, so it also uses `derive_change_id`. Same issue applies to apply.rs. So we have a cross-file bug: - `panel/commands.rs` is fixed (uses unique change_ids for re-enabled toggles) - `evolution/observe/shadow.rs` is NOT fixed (still uses `derive_change_id` via `from_proposal`) - `evolution/apply.rs::apply_from_consolidation` uses `auto_applied_from_proposal` which uses `from_proposal` which uses `derive_change_id` When a proposal is rolled back and then comes back through apply or shadow, the new CR will collide with the old rolled-back CR's `change_id`. This is a real cross-file inconsistency. Let me also verify whether `existing_open` in shadow.rs filters out the rolled-back CRs before letting a new write through. It does (status filter only includes Pending/Shadowing/ShadowPassed, excluding RolledBack). So the write will go through and create a new CR with `chg-pid` — collision with the old rolled-back row. This is a real cross-file issue worth flagging. Let me also look at the test file for memory:

458|/// 启动记忆整理调度器（App 启动时调用；bot_scheduler 同模式）：
459|/// 每 10 分钟检查一次配置，到点就跑一轮。LLM/解析失败静默记审计，不影响正常功能。
460|pub fn start_consolidation_scheduler(app: AppHandle) {
461|    tauri::async_runtime::spawn(async move {
462|        let mut ticker = tokio::time::interval(std::time::Duration::from_secs(SCHED_TICK_SECS));
463|        ticker.tick().await; // 消耗首个立即触发的 tick
464|        loop {
465|            ticker.tick().await;
466|            let cfg = crate::bot::load_config(&app)
467|                .memory_consolidation
468|                .unwrap_or_default();
469|            match classify_due(&cfg, now_ms()) {
470|                DueVerdict::Off => {}
471|                DueVerdict::InitBaseline => persist_last_run(&app),
472|                DueVerdict::Run => {
473|                    match run_consolidation(&app).await {
474|                        Ok(report) => {
475|                            crate::audit_event!(&app, crate::audit::AuditLevel::Info,
476|                                "memory.consolidate",
477|                                "merged" => report.merged, "distilled" => report.distilled,
478|                                "contradictions" => report.contradictions);
479|                        }
480|                        Err(e) => {
481|                            // LLM 不可用/解析失败：静默放弃本轮（审计可查），
482|                            // 仍推进 last_run_at 防下个 tick 立刻重试刷屏
483|                            crate::audit_event!(&app, crate::audit::AuditLevel::Warn,
484|                                "memory.consolidate_failed", "error" => e.message());
485|                        }
486|                    }
487|                    persist_last_run(&app);
488|                }
489|            }
490|        }
491|    });
