221|/// 新条目草稿
222|pub struct NewItem {
223|    pub kind: String,
224|    pub content: String,
225|    pub tags: Vec<String>,
226|    pub importance: i64,
227|    pub source: String,
228|}
229|
230|/// 写入（语义去重 + 容量淘汰）：
231|/// - embedding 为 Some 时先全表余弦去重：≥0.92 合并更新已有条目；0.75~0.92 仅记录为
232|///   冲突提示（返回值带出，不拦截）
233|/// - embedding 为 None（降级模式）跳过去重直接插入
234|/// 返回 (结果, 冲突提示列表[content 摘要])
235|pub fn insert_item(
236|    conn: &rusqlite::Connection,
237|    item: &NewItem,
238|    embedding: Option<&[f32]>,
239|    now_ms: i64,
240|) -> Result<(InsertOutcome, Vec<String>), String> {
241|    ensure_table(conn)?;
242|    let all = load_all(conn)?;
243|    // 语义去重（仅有向量时；降级模式无余弦可算，跳过）
244|    if let Some(emb) = embedding {
245|        let mut best: Option<(f64, &MemItem)> = None;
246|        let mut hints: Vec<(f64, &MemItem)> = Vec::new();
247|        for m in &all {
248|            if let Some(c) = cosine(Some(emb), m.embedding.as_deref()) {
249|                if c >= DEDUP_MERGE_COSINE {
250|                    if best.map_or(true, |(s, _)| c > s) {
251|                        best = Some((c, m));
252|                    }
253|                } else if c >= DEDUP_HINT_COSINE {
254|                    hints.push((c, m));
255|                }
256|            }
257|        }
258|        if let Some((_, target)) = best {
259|            // B2-1（P1-EV3）：lesson（evo: key）不许 merge 进异 key 既有行——
260|            // merge-on-write 是整行覆盖（content+tags 都换成 lesson 的），会把
261|            // 目标行劫持成 lesson、原记忆丢失。同 key = 本链路自己的重放，放行。
262|            let incoming_key = item.tags.first().cloned();
263|            let target_key = target.tags.first().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
264|            if incoming_key
265|                .as_deref()
266|                .map(|k| k.starts_with("evo:"))
267|                .unwrap_or(false)
268|                && target_key != incoming_key.unwrap_or_default()
269|            {
270|                return Ok((
271|                    InsertOutcome::RefusedForeignMerge {
272|                        target_key: target_key,
273|                    },
274|                    Vec::new(),
275|                ));
276|            }
277|            let orig_key = target.tags.first().cloned();
278|            conn.execute(
279|                "UPDATE mem_items SET content = ?1, tags = ?2, importance = ?3, source = ?4,
280|                        updated_at = ?5, access_count = access_count + 1, last_accessed_at = ?5,
281|                        embedding = ?6
282|                 WHERE id = ?7",
283|                rusqlite::params![
284|                    item.content,
285|                    item.tags.join(","),
286|                    item.importance.clamp(1, 5),
287|                    item.source,
288|                    ts_to_text(now_ms),
289|                    embedding_to_blob(emb),
290|                    target.id,
291|                ],
292|            )
293|            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
294|            let merged = MemItem {
295|                content: item.content.clone(),
296|                tags: item.tags.clone(),
297|                importance: item.importance.clamp(1, 5),
298|                source: item.source.clone(),
299|                updated_at_ms: now_ms,
300|                last_accessed_at_ms: Some(now_ms),
301|                access_count: target.access_count + 1,
302|                embedding: Some(emb.to_vec()),
303|                ..target.clone()
304|            };
305|            return Ok((
306|                InsertOutcome::Merged {
307|                    item: merged,
308|                    orig_key,
309|                },
310|                Vec::new(),
311|            ));
312|        }
313|        hints.sort_by(|a, b| b.0.partial_cmp(&a.0).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));
314|        let hint_texts: Vec<String> = hints
315|            .iter()
316|            .take(CONFLICT_HINT_TOP)
317|            .map(|(_, m)| {
318|                let key = m.tags.first().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
319|                if key.is_empty() {
320|                    m.content.chars().take(80).collect()
321|                } else {
322|                    format!(
323|                        "key={}, value={}",
324|                        key,
325|                        m.content.chars().take(80).collect::<String>()
326|                    )
327|                }
328|            })
329|            .collect();
330|        return insert_new(conn, item, embedding, now_ms).map(|outcome| (outcome, hint_texts));
331|    }
332|    insert_new(conn, item, embedding, now_ms).map(|outcome| (outcome, Vec::new()))
333|}

335|fn insert_new(
336|    conn: &rusqlite::Connection,
337|    item: &NewItem,
338|    embedding: Option<&[f32]>,
339|    now_ms: i64,
340|) -> Result<InsertOutcome, String> {
341|    if let Err(e) = evict_if_needed(conn, now_ms) {
342|        return Ok(InsertOutcome::RejectedFull(e));
343|    }
344|    let id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().simple().to_string();
345|    conn.execute(

348|        rusqlite::params![

357|        ],
358|    )
359|    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

364|        tags: item.tags.clone(),

382|/// 同 key 覆盖更新（不触发去重/淘汰；重算向量由调用方传入）。
383|/// 向量语义：content 变了 → 以新向量为准（None = 降级模式写，旧向量随内容一并作废弃 NULL，
384|/// 防语义检索按旧内容命中）；content 没变（仅动 importance/kind 等）→ 无新向量时保留旧向量。
385|pub fn update_by_id(
386|    conn: &rusqlite::Connection,
387|    id: &str,
388|    content: &str,
389|    importance: i64,

391|    kind: &str,

399|         WHERE id = ?7",

408|        ],
409|    )
410|    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
411|    Ok(())

434|/// 最旧 n 条指定 kind（Reflection 取最旧 10 条 summary），返回 (id, content)
435|pub fn oldest_by_kind(
436|    conn: &rusqlite::Connection,
437|    kind: &str,
438|    n: i64,
439|) -> Result<Vec<(String, String)>, String> {
440|    conn.prepare(
441|        "SELECT id, content FROM mem_items WHERE kind = ?1 ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT ?2",
442|    )
443|    .and_then(|mut s| {
444|        s.query_map(rusqlite::params![kind, n], |r| {
445|            Ok((r.get::<_, String>(0)?, r.get::<_, String>(1)?))
446|        })
447|        .map(|iter| iter.filter_map(|r| r.ok()).collect::<Vec<_>>())
448|    })
449|    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())
450|}
451|
452|/// 按 id 批量删除（Reflection 合成后清原摘要）
453|pub fn delete_by_ids(conn: &rusqlite::Connection, ids: &[String]) -> Result<usize, String> {
454|    let mut n = 0;
455|    for id in ids {
456|        n += conn
457|            .execute("DELETE FROM mem_items WHERE id = ?1", rusqlite::params![id])
458|            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
459|    }
460|    Ok(n)
461|}
462|
463|/// 命中刷新访问计数（注入路径；同一连接内原子）
464|pub fn touch_accessed(
465|    conn: &rusqlite::Connection,
466|    ids: &[String],
467|    now_ms: i64,
468|) -> Result<(), String> {
469|    let ts = ts_to_text(now_ms);
470|    for id in ids {
471|        conn.execute(
472|            "UPDATE mem_items SET access_count = access_count + 1, last_accessed_at = ?1 WHERE id = ?2",
473|            rusqlite::params![ts, id],
474|        )
475|        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
476|    }
477|    Ok(())
478|}

I've completed my review of `src-tauri/src/memory/store.rs`. Two minor observations were flagged via `code_comment`: 1. **Unnecessary `clone()` on `incoming_key`** (maintainability, low): The `.cloned()` is only consumed by `unwrap_or_default()` after being borrowed for `.starts_with()`. The whole block can be expressed with `&str` borrows, with the `String` allocation deferred to the variant-construction site. 2. **Field-type inconsistency between `Merged` and `RefusedForeignMerge`** (maintainability, low): `Merged.orig_key` is `Option<String>` but the new `RefusedForeignMerge.target_key` is `String` with `""` as an implicit "no-key" sentinel. Using `Option<String>` for the new field would be more idiomatic and consistent; the apply-layer consumer (modified in the same PR) would need to match. The logic itself is correct: the B2-1 protection correctly fires when an `evo:`-prefixed incoming key meets a different-key target (≥0.92 cosine), allows same-key self-replay, and lets non-lesson keys pass through unaffected. No issues were found under ownership/lifetime, error handling, concurrency, or security-sensitive code categories for this change.

434|/// 最旧 n 条指定 kind（Reflection 取最旧 10 条 summary），返回 (id, content)
435|pub fn oldest_by_kind(
436|    conn: &rusqlite::Connection,
437|    kind: &str,
438|    n: i64,
439|) -> Result<Vec<(String, String)>, String> {
440|    conn.prepare(
441|        "SELECT id, content FROM mem_items WHERE kind = ?1 ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT ?2",
442|    )
443|    .and_then(|mut s| {
444|        s.query_map(rusqlite::params![kind, n], |r| {
445|            Ok((r.get::<_, String>(0)?, r.get::<_, String>(1)?))
446|        })
447|        .map(|iter| iter.filter_map(|r| r.ok()).collect::<Vec<_>>())
448|    })
449|    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())
450|}
451|
452|/// 按 id 批量删除（Reflection 合成后清原摘要）
453|pub fn delete_by_ids(conn: &rusqlite::Connection, ids: &[String]) -> Result<usize, String> {
454|    let mut n = 0;
455|    for id in ids {
456|        n += conn
457|            .execute("DELETE FROM mem_items WHERE id = ?1", rusqlite::params![id])
458|            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
459|    }
460|    Ok(n)
461|}
462|
463|/// 命中刷新访问计数（注入路径；同一连接内原子）
464|pub fn touch_accessed(
465|    conn: &rusqlite::Connection,
466|    ids: &[String],
467|    now_ms: i64,
468|) -> Result<(), String> {
469|    let ts = ts_to_text(now_ms);
470|    for id in ids {
471|        conn.execute(
472|            "UPDATE mem_items SET access_count = access_count + 1, last_accessed_at = ?1 WHERE id = ?2",
473|            rusqlite::params![ts, id],
474|        )
475|        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
476|    }
477|    Ok(())
478|}

84|fn blob_to_embedding(b: &[u8]) -> Option<Vec<f32>> {

86|        return None;
87|    }
88|    Some(
89|        b.chunks_exact(4)
90|            .map(|c| f32::from_le_bytes([c[0], c[1], c[2], c[3]]))

135|/// 余弦相似度（向量均假定已 L2 归一化；维度不齐/缺失 → None）
136|pub fn cosine(a: Option<&[f32]>, b: Option<&[f32]>) -> Option<f64> {
137|    let (a, b) = (a?, b?);
138|    if a.len() != b.len() || a.is_empty() {
139|        return None;
140|    }
141|    let dot: f64 = a
142|        .iter()
143|        .zip(b)
144|        .map(|(x, y)| (*x as f64) * (*y as f64))
145|        .sum();
146|    let na = a.iter().map(|x| (*x as f64).powi(2)).sum::<f64>().sqrt();
147|    let nb = b.iter().map(|x| (*x as f64).powi(2)).sum::<f64>().sqrt();
148|    if na == 0.0 || nb == 0.0 {
149|        return None;
150|    }
151|    Some(dot / (na * nb))
152|}

154|/// 受保护条目：importance=5 且用户口述 —— 永不被容量淘汰
155|pub fn is_protected(item: &MemItem) -> bool {
156|    item.importance >= 5 && item.source == "user_stated"

159|/// 淘汰分（越低越先淘汰）：importance 权重最高 + 最近访问/更新新近度 + 访问次数
160|pub(crate) fn evict_score(item: &MemItem, now_ms: i64) -> f64 {
161|    let base = item
162|        .last_accessed_at_ms
163|        .unwrap_or(item.updated_at_ms)
164|        .max(item.created_at_ms);
165|    let age_days = ((now_ms - base) as f64 / 86_400_000.0).max(0.0);
166|    item.importance as f64 * 2.0
167|        + (-age_days / 30.0).exp()
168|        + (1.0 + item.access_count.max(0) as f64).ln() / 5.0
169|}

172|fn evict_if_needed(conn: &rusqlite::Connection, now_ms: i64) -> Result<(), String> {
173|    let count: i64 = conn
174|        .query_row("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mem_items", [], |r| r.get(0))
175|        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
176|    if count < MAX_MEM_ITEMS {

183|        .min_by(|a, b| {

185|                .partial_cmp(&evict_score(b, now_ms))
186|                .unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)
187|        })
188|        .map(|m| m.id.clone());
189|    match victim {

231|/// - embedding 为 Some 时先全表余弦去重：≥0.92 合并更新已有条目；0.75~0.92 仅记录为
232|///   冲突提示（返回值带出，不拦截）
233|/// - embedding 为 None（降级模式）跳过去重直接插入
234|/// 返回 (结果, 冲突提示列表[content 摘要])
235|pub fn insert_item(
236|    conn: &rusqlite::Connection,
237|    item: &NewItem,
238|    embedding: Option<&[f32]>,
239|    now_ms: i64,
240|) -> Result<(InsertOutcome, Vec<String>), String> {
241|    ensure_table(conn)?;
242|    let all = load_all(conn)?;
243|    // 语义去重（仅有向量时；降级模式无余弦可算，跳过）
244|    if let Some(emb) = embedding {
245|        let mut best: Option<(f64, &MemItem)> = None;
246|        let mut hints: Vec<(f64, &MemItem)> = Vec::new();
247|        for m in &all {
248|            if let Some(c) = cosine(Some(emb), m.embedding.as_deref()) {
249|                if c >= DEDUP_MERGE_COSINE {
250|                    if best.map_or(true, |(s, _)| c > s) {
251|                        best = Some((c, m));
252|                    }
253|                } else if c >= DEDUP_HINT_COSINE {
254|                    hints.push((c, m));
255|                }
256|            }
257|        }
258|        if let Some((_, target)) = best {
259|            // B2-1（P1-EV3）：lesson（evo: key）不许 merge 进异 key 既有行——
260|            // merge-on-write 是整行覆盖（content+tags 都换成 lesson 的），会把
261|            // 目标行劫持成 lesson、原记忆丢失。同 key = 本链路自己的重放，放行。
262|            let incoming_key = item.tags.first().cloned();
263|            let target_key = target.tags.first().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
264|            if incoming_key
265|                .as_deref()
266|                .map(|k| k.starts_with("evo:"))
267|                .unwrap_or(false)
268|                && target_key != incoming_key.unwrap_or_default()
269|            {
270|                return Ok((
271|                    InsertOutcome::RefusedForeignMerge {
272|                        target_key: target_key,
273|                    },
274|                    Vec::new(),
275|                ));
276|            }
277|            let orig_key = target.tags.first().cloned();
278|            conn.execute(
279|                "UPDATE mem_items SET content = ?1, tags = ?2, importance = ?3, source = ?4,
280|                        updated_at = ?5, access_count = access_count + 1, last_accessed_at = ?5,
281|                        embedding = ?6
282|                 WHERE id = ?7",
283|                rusqlite::params![
284|                    item.content,
285|                    item.tags.join(","),
286|                    item.importance.clamp(1, 5),
287|                    item.source,
288|                    ts_to_text(now_ms),
289|                    embedding_to_blob(emb),
290|                    target.id,
291|                ],
292|            )
293|            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
294|            let merged = MemItem {
295|                content: item.content.clone(),
296|                tags: item.tags.clone(),
297|                importance: item.importance.clamp(1, 5),
298|                source: item.source.clone(),
299|                updated_at_ms: now_ms,
300|                last_accessed_at_ms: Some(now_ms),
301|                access_count: target.access_count + 1,
302|                embedding: Some(emb.to_vec()),
303|                ..target.clone()
304|            };
305|            return Ok((
306|                InsertOutcome::Merged {
307|                    item: merged,
308|                    orig_key,
309|                },
310|                Vec::new(),
311|            ));
312|        }
313|        hints.sort_by(|a, b| b.0.partial_cmp(&a.0).unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal));
314|        let hint_texts: Vec<String> = hints
315|            .iter()
316|            .take(CONFLICT_HINT_TOP)
317|            .map(|(_, m)| {
318|                let key = m.tags.first().cloned().unwrap_or_default();
319|                if key.is_empty() {
320|                    m.content.chars().take(80).collect()
321|                } else {
322|                    format!(
323|                        "key={}, value={}",
324|                        key,
325|                        m.content.chars().take(80).collect::<String>()
326|                    )
327|                }
328|            })
329|            .collect();
330|        return insert_new(conn, item, embedding, now_ms).map(|outcome| (outcome, hint_texts));
331|    }
332|    insert_new(conn, item, embedding, now_ms).map(|outcome| (outcome, Vec::new()))
333|}

335|fn insert_new(
336|    conn: &rusqlite::Connection,
337|    item: &NewItem,
338|    embedding: Option<&[f32]>,
339|    now_ms: i64,
340|) -> Result<InsertOutcome, String> {
341|    if let Err(e) = evict_if_needed(conn, now_ms) {
342|        return Ok(InsertOutcome::RejectedFull(e));
343|    }
344|    let id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().simple().to_string();
345|    conn.execute(
346|        "INSERT INTO mem_items (id, kind, content, tags, importance, source, created_at, updated_at, embedding)
347|         VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6, ?7, ?7, ?8)",
348|        rusqlite::params![
349|            id,
350|            item.kind,
351|            item.content,
352|            item.tags.join(","),
353|            item.importance.clamp(1, 5),
354|            item.source,
355|            ts_to_text(now_ms),
356|            embedding.map(embedding_to_blob),
357|        ],
358|    )
359|    .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
360|    Ok(InsertOutcome::Inserted(MemItem {
361|        id,
362|        kind: item.kind.clone(),
363|        content: item.content.clone(),
364|        tags: item.tags.clone(),
365|        importance: item.importance.clamp(1, 5),
366|        source: item.source.clone(),
367|        created_at_ms: now_ms,
368|        updated_at_ms: now_ms,
369|        access_count: 0,
370|        last_accessed_at_ms: None,
371|        embedding: embedding.map(|e| e.to_vec()),
372|    }))
373|}
